name: proto-rpc-uncalled-with-go-handler
description: An RPC with a gRPC handler and a Connect handler and no client call has two dead implementers, one per handler, each carrying the pending finding of its method, and the client method of each runtime is unreferenced. The embedded Connect Unimplemented handler supplies no method the program uses, because the handler's own method shadows the one it promotes and the Connect handler interface has no other, so the field is an unused member of the report.
